title: Loop Runner Arcade
intro: Loops repeat your magic over and over! Predict the runs, fix the spins, and stack the blocks. First-try wins earn ⭐⭐⭐!

rounds.explain: range(3) counts 0, 1, 2, it starts at 0 and stops before 3.

rounds.prompt: How many times does range(5) repeat?
rounds.explain: range(5) gives 0,1,2,3,4, that's 5 numbers, so 5 loops.

rounds.prompt: This while loop runs forever! Pick the fix.
options: Add count = count + 1 inside the loop
rounds.explain: Without changing count, the condition stays True forever. Increase it so the loop can end.

rounds.prompt: What is the LAST number printed?
rounds.explain: break stops the loop when n is 3, so the last printed number is 2.

rounds.prompt: What does continue do inside a loop?
options: Skips to the next turn of the loop
Starts the loop over from zero
rounds.explain: continue skips the rest of THIS turn and jumps straight to the next one. (break stops it.)

rounds.prompt: Build a loop that prints each number from 0 to 2.
rounds.explain: The for line sets up the loop, and the indented print runs each turn.
